data.title: 欧根亲王 · 办公室桌沿的微风撩拨
data.description: 深夜指挥官办公室的百叶窗外倒映着港区绚丽夜景。欧根亲王斜倚在红木办公桌边沿，制服外套随意搭在一旁，贴身衬衫微解领口。黑丝长腿优雅叠放，她一手托着下巴，绯红色的挑染发丝在微风中轻扬，眼角泪痣因狡黠的笑意而分外迷人。
data.location: private command office with locked door and evening city lights
data.action: perched gracefully on edge of mahogany office desk, uniform jacket draped on chair, loosened collar exposing collarbone, black pantyhose, chin resting on palm, charming teasing smirk
data.lighting: cool blue city skyline neon contrasting with warm desk lamp
data.promptProse: Perched on the edge of an executive desk overlooking a glowing nocturnal skyline, Prinz Eugen smiles teasingly. Her military jacket is set aside, revealing an open collar, black pantyhose, and her signature beauty mark.
data.animaCaption: Prinz Eugen perching on an office desk at night with an alluring, confident smirk.
